title: Each lead change adds one history entry, lines that move add none
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission and Work Orders create-and-edit; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A work order whose lead change moves at least two implicit lines; access to the work order's audit history.
custom_steps:
1. Change the lead of the work order.
  2. Open the audit history.
  3. Confirm exactly one entry with previous lead, new lead, the logged-in actor, and time.
  4. Confirm no separate entries were added for the implicit line movements.
  5. Separately change a technician directly on a line and confirm the existing line audit still records it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Every lead change records exactly one audit entry with the previous lead, new lead, the logged-in actor, and the time.
  • No separate audit entries are created for the implicit line movements caused by a lead change.
  • Technician changes made directly on a work-order line keep their existing line auditing.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10047 — Story 4 Reassign or unassign the lead technician. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S4-R9, S4-R17, S4-R18 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R9: “Every lead-change path records one audit entry with the previous lead, new lead, logged-in actor, and time.”
  • S4-R17: “Do not create separate audit entries for implicit line movements caused by a lead change.”
  • S4-R18: “Continue existing line auditing for technician changes made directly on a work order line.”
